goal: Prevent dropping pipelined HTTP responses when a client sends a closing request
agreement: Concept support for updating keep-alive state alongside the send buffer (winterrdog)
Verified test reproduces the race when the fix is reverted (hodlinator)
Concept approval without stated reasons, noting low review priority (pinheadmz)
Thinks review can be delayed because the scenario is hard to reach in practice (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because pipelined requests followed immediately by a close connection are rare in RPC workloads
Fixes an edge-case race condition where clients are prematurely disconnected before responses are sent
